raw_html: [[Eternal Fire]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Eternal Fire]]:''' While you are wearing this item, your melee, ranged, and unarmed attacks gain the [[Flaming Burst#Flaming Burst|Flaming Burst]] ability. (This weapon is sheathed in fire. The weapon deals an additional 1 to 6 fire damage each hit. In addition, critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 fire damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 critical multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.)
